critical_path.objective: Obtain independent leakage-resistant human structural gold for the six source-custody-qualified public-domain heldout cases.
critical_path.first_action: Provide the gold-empty adjudication packets to independent human adjudicators under HUMAN-ADJUDICATION-PACKET-CONTRACT-v1.json; require two independent reviews for high-risk tasks and preserve disagreement/UNRESOLVED states.
critical_path.exact_gate: All 18 task packets validate against the adjudication contract and exact SOURCE-HELDOUT-002A passage digests, with required independent reviews present, no fabricated consensus, and model_input_contains_gold=false.
critical_path.pass_proves: Independent structural gold exists for the frozen heldout set and can be used, after prediction freeze, for real Candidate-002 scoring. It does not prove model quality by itself.
critical_path.pass_unlocks: Real learned/model prediction freeze, leakage-safe heldout scoring, Candidate-002 promotion review, and only then reevaluation of whether a new exact-SHA A-01 gate has a legitimate completion delta.
critical_path.on_failure: Repair only the defective or incomplete human packet/adjudication boundary. Preserve source digests, frozen passage selection, disagreement and gold isolation; do not replace passages or infer missing human labels.

a01_next.reason: The last Literary A-01 subject already has a conforming exact-SHA PASS and may not be rerun unchanged. SOURCE-HELDOUT-002A did not require A-01. The current unresolved delta is independent human adjudication, which A-01 cannot create or substitute.
a01_next.reevaluate_when: Human adjudication is complete, real model predictions are frozen with gold hidden, hosted scoring/prequalification is complete, and a new registered exact-SHA A-01 gate has a distinct runner-specific completion delta.
